description: Evidence-backed fact store for the signed-in user (and organisation). action=get returns the latest version of facts (pass subject and key for one, or subject/prefix to list); action=history returns every version of one subject+key; action=put records a user assertion, which is unconfirmed until the user confirms it; action=confirm adds the confirmed version after the user said it is right. Facts are insert-only: a put adds a new version. Only a connector or the platform's own tools produce verified facts; a put never does. Every fact lists its sources with step_id, job_id, url, fetched_at, tier and evidence.

kind.description: Value type slug, e.g. address, money, text

prefix.description: List facts whose key starts with this (get)

subject.description: Whose fact, e.g. user or org.acme

name: alterlab_facts
title: Hands Facts
